一夜山巅静谧，风清月朗。

经过整夜调息休养，众人损耗的灵气、心神、蛊力皆恢复大半。晨光再次破晓，染红长白山连绵山巅，云海翻涌，霞光漫山，景色壮阔苍茫，再无半分往日阴森邪异之气。

众人早早起身，简单整理行装法器，补满符箓丹药、配齐暗器蛊虫，神色肃穆，整装待发。

今日目标明确：深入长白山后山密林，搜寻织田美子口中所说的隐秘地底溶洞，找出东瀛三派潜藏的隐秘据点、遗留传承与暗藏后手，挖出深埋的伏笔隐患。

织田美子依旧被灵绳禁锢、修为封印，由李二牛押着随行。虽她坦言不知核心隐秘据点所在，但她身为九菊一派中层养蛊师，熟悉长白山山林地形、邪派惯用隐秘选址规律，随行带路，能省去不少摸索时间。

“长白山后山，山势更险，古木更密，幽谷裂谷、地底溶洞数不胜数。”织田美子行走在队伍侧方，目光望向后方连绵的原始密林，语气平淡，“三大派挑选隐秘据点，向来偏爱三重选址：隐蔽幽谷腹地、绝壁天然溶洞、地底暗河连通之地，依山靠阴、聚气藏煞，不易被外界探查发现。”

“明面上的祭坛摆在主峰绝顶，引人目光，充当明棋；真正的据点藏在后山幽谷地底，暗河连通，进退自如，充当暗棋。就算明面上的势力全灭，暗棋依旧可以蛰伏传承，等待时机卷土重来。”

胡九郎走在队伍最前方，天眼俯瞰后山山林地势脉络，神识铺展方圆数里，探查地气流转、阴煞隐点、人为布阵痕迹：“后山山林气场杂乱，有多处地气异常节点，隐约有人工改动地脉、隐匿气场的痕迹，确实有长期盘踞、暗中经营的迹象。”

范梦雪周身雷光微敛，雷气感应周遭阴邪残留：“林间零星残留淡淡的咒气、蛊气余韵，年代久远，不是近年留下，而是数十年长期浸染的痕迹，印证了这里早就被当作隐秘据点经营。”

众人不再多言，结成紧凑攻守阵型，循着后山古道，缓缓踏入原始密林。

后山古木参天，枝干交错遮天蔽日，林下荒草没膝，藤蔓缠绕虬结，人迹罕至，荒寂原始。林间听不到寻常鸟兽啼鸣，透着一股与世隔绝的幽深静谧，偶尔山风穿过林梢，带着呜呜低鸣，平添几分诡异神秘。

越往深处走，山势越发崎岖，沟壑纵横、幽谷罗列、绝壁林立，雾气在林间低洼处萦绕汇聚，朦胧迷离，极易迷失方向，也便于暗藏杀机、布设迷阵。

李二牛全程放开仙家灵感，感应山林地气走向、阴煞藏匿点位、生人隐匿气息，一路指引路线，避开天然迷谷、地气凶煞死角，同时警惕暗处可能潜藏的留守暗哨、隐秘式神。

钱丹袖中蛊虫四散低空飞行，感应地底蛊穴、暗河脉络、邪蛊残留气息，提前标记可疑方位；杨瑞手持法牌，灵光流转，随时预警周遭是否有隐匿幻阵、迷魂阴阵；李安琪留意山体岩壁结构，辨识人工开凿痕迹、伪装洞口。

队伍稳步深入后山，一路避开幽谷陷阱、地气凶地、浓雾迷障，顺着灵气异常节点逐步排查，行进约莫一个时辰，深入后山腹地。

The mountain top was quiet one night, the wind was clear and the moon was bright.

After a whole night of rest and relaxation, most of the lost spiritual energy, mind, and Gu power of everyone were restored.The morning light breaks again, dyeing the tops of the Changbai Mountains red. The sea of ​​clouds rolls in, and the rays of light fill the mountains. The scenery is magnificent and boundless, and there is no longer any gloomy and evil atmosphere in the past.

Everyone got up early, simply packed their luggage and packed their magic weapons, replenished their talismans with elixirs, and prepared their hidden weapons, Gu Insects, with solemn expressions and ready to go.

Today's goal is clear: go deep into the dense forest at the back of Changbai Mountain, search for the hidden underground caves mentioned by Oda Miko, find out the hidden strongholds, legacy and hidden back-up plans of the three Japanese sects, and dig out the hidden hidden dangers.

Oda Meiko was still imprisoned by the spiritual rope and sealed by cultivation, and was escorted by Li Erniu.Although she admitted that she did not know the location of the core secret stronghold, as a middle-level Gu cultivator of the Jiuju sect, she was familiar with the forest terrain of Changbai Mountain and the secret location selection rules used by the evil sect. She could lead the way and save a lot of time in searching.

"In the back mountain of Changbai Mountain, the mountains are more dangerous, the ancient trees are denser, and there are countless valleys, rifts, and underground caves." Miko Oda walked on the side of the team, looking at the continuous virgin forest behind, and said in a calm tone, "The three major sects choose secret strongholds, and they always prefer three locations: the hinterland of hidden valleys, natural caves on cliffs, and places connected by underground rivers. They are close to the mountains and shade, gathering Qi and hiding evil, so they are not easy to be discovered by outsiders."

"The altar on the bright side is placed at the top of the main peak, attracting attention, and serves as a bright chess piece; the real stronghold is hidden in the deep valley behind the mountain, connected by underground rivers, and can advance and retreat freely, serving as a dark chess piece. Even if all the forces on the bright side are wiped out, the dark chess piece can still lie dormant and pass on, waiting for the opportunity to make a comeback."

Hu Jiulang was walking at the front of the team. He looked down at the terrain of the back mountain and forest with his heavenly eyes. His spiritual consciousness spread for several miles, detecting the earth's air circulation, hidden spots of evil spirits, and traces of man-made formations: "The aura of the back mountain forest is messy, with many abnormal nodes of the earth's air. There are vague traces of artificial changes in the earth's veins and concealment of the aura. There are indeed signs of long-term entrenchment and secret management."

The thunder light around Fan Mengxue was slightly restrained, and the thunder energy sensed the lingering evil around him: "There are scattered faint lingering traces of curse and poison in the forest. They are very old. They are not left in recent years, but are traces of decades of long-term infiltration, which proves that this place has long been operated as a secret stronghold."

Everyone said no more, formed a compact offensive and defensive formation, followed the ancient road in the back mountain, and slowly entered the primitive dense forest.

The ancient trees in the back mountain are towering, their intertwined branches block out the sky and the sun, the grass under the forest is knee-deep, and the vines are entangled and knotted. It is inaccessible and primitive.There are no ordinary cries of birds and animals in the forest, which exudes a sense of deep tranquility that is isolated from the world. Occasionally, the mountain wind blows through the forest tops, carrying a low whine, which adds a bit of weirdness and mystery.

As you go deeper, the mountains become more rugged, with ravines, valleys, and cliffs. The mist lingers and gathers in the low-lying areas of the forest, making it hazy and confusing. It is easy to lose your way, and it is also convenient for hiding murderous intentions and setting up mazes.

Li Erniu let go of the inspiration of the immortal family throughout the process, sensing the direction of the mountain and forest's earth energy, the hiding spots of evil spirits, and the hidden auras of strangers. He guided the route along the way to avoid natural valleys and evil corners of the earth's energy. At the same time, he was alert to the hidden sentries and hidden shikigami that might be lurking in the dark.

The Gu insects in Qian Dan's sleeves are flying at low altitude, sensing underground Gu caves, underground river veins, and the residual breath of evil Gu, and marking suspicious locations in advance; Yang Rui holds magic cards, and his spiritual light circulates, warning at any time whether there are hidden phantom formations or ecstasy formations around him; Li Anqi pays attention to the structure of mountain rock walls, identifying traces of artificial excavations, and camouflaging cave entrances.

The team steadily went deep into the back mountain, avoiding traps in deep valleys, dangerous places, and dense fog. They followed the abnormal nodes of the aura and gradually investigated. After traveling for about an hour, they went deep into the hinterland of the back mountain.
